# `r if (!is.null(params$cancer_type)) paste(params$cancer_type)`

```{r, setup, include = FALSE}
set.seed(1)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = FALSE,
                      dev = "ragg_png", dpi = 300)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(tidyverse)
library(reactable)
library(ggpmisc)
library(maftools)

DATA_ROOT <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging/TCGA-GDC/mutation"
SCRIPT_ROOT <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging/scripts/mutation"
RESULTS_ROOT <- "/restricted/projectnb/agedisease/projects/pancancer_aging/results/mutation"
```

```{r}
selected_cancer_type <- params$cancer_type
include_gender <- params$include_gender
include_race <- params$include_race
include_HPV_status <- params$include_HPV_status
include_subtype <- params$include_subtype
include_grade <- params$include_grade
include_purity <- params$include_purity

races_included <- params$races_included
if (length(races_included) == 1 && !is.na(races_included) && grepl(",", races_included)) {
  races_included <- trimws(strsplit(races_included, ",")[[1]])
}

grades_included <- params$grades_included
if (length(grades_included) == 1 && !is.na(grades_included) && grepl(",", grades_included)) {
  grades_included <- trimws(strsplit(grades_included, ",")[[1]])
}
```

```{r}
path_SE_input <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "processed_data", "all")
path_SE_output <- file.path(DATA_ROOT, "processed_data", "filtered")

dir.create(path_SE_output, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r}
source(file.path(SCRIPT_ROOT, "utils.r"))
```

This script performs EDA and filtering on Mutation data for `r selected_cancer_type`.

Model covariates for this cancer type:

Gender: `r include_gender`
Race: `r include_race`
Subtype: `r include_subtype`
HPV Status: `r include_HPV_status`
Grade: `r include_grade`
Purity: `r include_purity`

# Load Data

```{r}
input_file <- file.path(path_SE_input, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_binary-mutation.rds"))

if (!file.exists(input_file)) stop("Input SE file not found: ", input_file)

se <- readRDS(input_file)

for (aname in assayNames(se)) {
  if (inherits(assay(se, aname), "table")) {
    assay(se, aname) <- unclass(assay(se, aname))
  }
}

initial_n <- ncol(se)

cat("Initial number of samples:", initial_n, "\n")
cat("Initial number of genes:", nrow(se), "\n")

if (ncol(se) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No samples found for ", selected_cancer_type, ". Check input data."))
}
```

# Calculate TMB (Tumor Mutation Burden)

TMB is calculated using `maftools::tmb()` on the MAF object constructed from raw GDC downloads within pancancer_aging.

```{r}
maf_dir <- file.path(
  DATA_ROOT, "raw_data", "project_downloads", selected_cancer_type,
  "Simple_Nucleotide_Variation", "Masked_Somatic_Mutation"
)

if (!dir.exists(maf_dir)) stop("MAF download directory not found: ", maf_dir)

maf_files <- list.files(maf_dir, pattern = "\\.maf\\.gz$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)
cat("Reading", length(maf_files), "MAF files for", selected_cancer_type, "\n")

maf_combined <- data.table::rbindlist(
  lapply(maf_files, function(f) data.table::fread(f, skip = "Hugo_Symbol")),
  fill = TRUE
)
maf <- maftools::read.maf(maf_combined, removeDuplicatedVariants = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

tmb_df <- maftools::tmb(maf)
tmb_df$sampleid <- substr(tmb_df$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1, 12)
tmb_df <- tmb_df[!duplicated(tmb_df$sampleid), ]

colData(se)$tmb_total <- tmb_df$total[match(colnames(se), tmb_df$sampleid)]
cat("Calculated TMB using maftools::tmb() for", sum(!is.na(colData(se)$tmb_total)), "samples\n")
cat("TMB range:", min(colData(se)$tmb_total, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(colData(se)$tmb_total, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
```

# Rebuild "all" Binary Matrix

Rebuild the "all" assay using `maftools::mutCountMatrix()` to match the oralcancer pipeline methodology (replacing Payton's `table()`-based matrix).

```{r}
all_count <- maftools::mutCountMatrix(maf, includeSyn = FALSE, removeNonMutated = FALSE)

colnames(all_count) <- substr(colnames(all_count), 1, 12)
all_count <- all_count[, !duplicated(colnames(all_count))]

all_binary <- ifelse(all_count > 0, 1, 0)

shared_samples <- intersect(colnames(se), colnames(all_binary))
shared_genes <- intersect(rownames(se), rownames(all_binary))

se <- se[shared_genes, shared_samples]
assay(se, "all") <- all_binary[shared_genes, shared_samples]

cat("Rebuilt 'all' assay via mutCountMatrix():", nrow(se), "genes x", ncol(se), "samples\n")
```

# Filter 1: Remove Missing Age

This filter is applied for every cancer type.

```{r}
cat("Samples with missing age:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$Age)), "\n")
se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$Age)]
cat("After filtering age:", ncol(se), "\n")
```

# Filter 2a: Keep Only HPV-Negative Samples (HNSC only)

This filter is only applied when cancer_type = TCGA-HNSC and include_HPV_status = TRUE.

```{r}
if (selected_cancer_type == "TCGA-HNSC" && include_HPV_status == TRUE) {
  cat("HPV status distribution BEFORE filtering:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$HPV.status, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$HPV.status) & colData(se)$HPV.status == "Negative"]

  cat("Samples remaining after filtering HPV-negative:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```

# Filter 2b: Remove Samples with Missing Subtype

This filter is applied when include_subtype = TRUE.

```{r}
if (include_subtype == TRUE) {
  cat("Samples with missing subtype:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$subtype_selected)), "\n")
  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$subtype_selected)]
  cat("Samples remaining after filtering missing subtype:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```


# Filter 3: Hypermutation (TMB < 1000)

Per Chatsirisupachai et al. 2021, restricting analysis to <1000 non-silent mutations.

```{r}
cat("TMB distribution BEFORE filtering:\n")
print(summary(colData(se)$tmb_total))

n_hyper <- sum(colData(se)$tmb_total >= 1000, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Removing", n_hyper, "hypermutated samples (TMB >= 1000).\n")

se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$tmb_total) & colData(se)$tmb_total < 1000]
cat("Samples remaining after hypermutation filter:", ncol(se), "\n")
```

# Filter 4: Purity

```{r}
if (include_purity == TRUE) {
  cat("Samples with missing purity:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$purity)), "\n")
  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$purity)]
  cat("After purity filtering:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```

# Filter 5: Grade (Recode & Filter)

Combines G3/G4 into a single category. Removes NAs and filters to specified grade levels.

```{r}
if (include_grade == TRUE) {
  cat("\nOriginal grade distribution BEFORE recoding:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$histological_grade, useNA = "always"))

  coldata <- colData(se) %>% as.data.frame()

  coldata$grade <- case_when(
    coldata$histological_grade == "G1" ~ "G1",
    coldata$histological_grade == "G2" ~ "G2",
    coldata$histological_grade %in% c("G3", "G4") ~ "G3/G4",
    coldata$histological_grade == "GX" ~ "GX",
    coldata$histological_grade == "High Grade" ~ "High Grade",
    coldata$histological_grade == "Low Grade" ~ "Low Grade",
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  )

  se <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = assays(se),
    rowData = rowData(se),
    colData = coldata
  )

  cat("\nRecoded grade distribution BEFORE removing NAs:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$grade, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$grade)]

  grades_recoded_included <- unique(case_when(
    grades_included %in% c("G3", "G4") ~ "G3/G4",
    grades_included %in% c("G1", "G2", "GX") ~ grades_included,
    TRUE ~ grades_included
  ))

  se <- se[, colData(se)$grade %in% grades_recoded_included]

  cat("\nAfter grade filtering:", ncol(se), "\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$grade, useNA = "always"))
}
```

# Filter 6: Gender

```{r}
if (include_gender == TRUE) {
  cat("Samples with missing gender:", sum(is.na(colData(se)$gender)), "\n")
  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$gender)]
  cat("After filtering gender:", ncol(se), "\n")
}
```

# Filter 7: Race

Recodes 'not reported' to NA, removes NAs, and filters for included races.

```{r}
if (include_race == TRUE) {
  cat("Race distribution BEFORE filtering:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))

  coldata <- colData(se) %>% as.data.frame()
  coldata$race <- if_else(coldata$race == "not reported", NA_character_, coldata$race)

  se <- SummarizedExperiment(
    assays = assays(se),
    rowData = rowData(se),
    colData = coldata
  )

  cat("\nRace distribution AFTER recoding 'not reported' to NA:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, !is.na(colData(se)$race)]

  cat("\nRace distribution AFTER removing NAs:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))

  se <- se[, colData(se)$race %in% races_included]

  cat("\nRace distribution AFTER keeping only specified races:\n")
  print(table(colData(se)$race, useNA = "always"))
}

cat("\nFinal samples after all filters:", ncol(se), "\n")

if (ncol(se) == 0) {
  stop(paste0("No samples remain for ", selected_cancer_type, " after filtering. Check covariate parameters."))
}

final_n <- ncol(se)

if ((final_n / initial_n) < 0.7) {
  stop(paste0(
    "More than 30% of initial samples were removed for ", selected_cancer_type,
    " after filtering. Please check metadata and covariate selection carefully before proceeding."
  ))
}
```

# EDA {.tabset}

## TMB Distribution

```{r}
ggplot(as.data.frame(colData(se)), aes(x = tmb_total)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 50, fill = "#4271AE", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "TMB Distribution (Filtered)", x = "TMB", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Age Distribution (all samples)

```{r}
ggplot(as.data.frame(colData(se)), aes(x = Age)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "#1ABC9C", color = "white") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(colData(se)$Age, na.rm = TRUE), linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  labs(title = paste("Histogram of Age at Index -", selected_cancer_type), x = "Age at index", y = "Frequency") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Top 20 Mutated Genes

```{r}
if ("all" %in% assayNames(se)) {
  mat <- assay(se, "all")
  top_genes <- rowSums(mat) %>%
    sort(decreasing = TRUE) %>%
    head(20) %>%
    as.data.frame() %>%
    setNames("Count") %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    mutate(Percent = (Count / ncol(se)) * 100)

  ggplot(top_genes, aes(x = reorder(Gene, Count), y = Count, fill = Percent)) +
    geom_col() +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Top 20 Mutated Genes", x = "Gene") +
    theme_minimal()
}
```

## Missing Value Counts per Variable

```{r}
covariates <- c("Age", "tmb_total")
if (include_gender) covariates <- c(covariates, "gender")
if (include_race) covariates <- c(covariates, "race")
if (include_subtype) covariates <- c(covariates, "subtype_selected")
if (include_HPV_status) covariates <- c(covariates, "HPV.status")
if (include_grade) covariates <- c(covariates, "grade")
if (include_purity) covariates <- c(covariates, "purity")

available_covariates <- covariates[covariates %in% names(colData(se))]
cov_data <- as.data.frame(colData(se)[, available_covariates])

missing_summary <- cov_data %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_missing") %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_missing = n_missing / nrow(cov_data) * 100)

reactable_pretty(missing_summary)
```

## Age Distribution over Categorical Covariate Levels

```{r}
discrete_vars <- c()
if (include_gender) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "gender")
if (include_race) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "race")
if (include_subtype) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "subtype_selected")
if (include_HPV_status) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "HPV.status")
if (include_grade) discrete_vars <- c(discrete_vars, "grade")

if (length(discrete_vars) > 0) {
  discrete_vars <- discrete_vars[discrete_vars %in% names(cov_data)]

  if (length(discrete_vars) > 0) {
    plot_data <- cov_data %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(all_of(discrete_vars), names_to = "name", values_to = "value") %>%
      dplyr::filter(!is.na(value), !is.na(Age))

    if (nrow(plot_data) > 0 && length(unique(plot_data$name)) > 0) {
      count_labels <- plot_data %>%
        dplyr::group_by(name, value) %>%
        dplyr::summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop")

      p <- plot_data %>%
        ggplot(aes(x = value, y = Age)) +
        geom_boxplot() +
        geom_text(
          data = count_labels, aes(label = paste0("n=", n), y = Inf),
          vjust = 1.5, size = 3
        ) +
        ggplot2::facet_wrap(~name, scales = "free_x") +
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

      print(p)
    } else {
      cat("No non-NA values in discrete covariates after filtering.\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("Selected discrete covariates not found in data.\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("No discrete covariates selected.\n")
}
```

## Age Distribution vs Continuous Covariates

```{r}
if (include_purity == TRUE && "purity" %in% names(cov_data)) {
  n_missing_purity <- sum(is.na(cov_data$purity))

  p <- ggplot(cov_data, aes(x = purity, y = Age)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
    labs(caption = paste0("n_missing = ", n_missing_purity)) +
    theme_bw()

  print(p)
} else {
  cat("No continuous covariates selected (purity not included or not available).\n")
}
```

## TMB vs Age

```{r}
ggplot(as.data.frame(colData(se)), aes(x = Age, y = tmb_total)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "blue") +
  labs(title = "TMB vs Age", x = "Age", y = "TMB (Total)") +
  theme_bw()
```

```{r}
output_file <- file.path(path_SE_output, paste0(selected_cancer_type, "_mutation-filtered-final.rds"))
saveRDS(se, output_file)
cat("Saved filtered SE to:", output_file, "\n")
```
